label: What needs attention
sql: SELECT event_name AS event, hazard_family AS type, severity_score AS severity, state_or_region AS region, impact_summary AS summary FROM gold_events WHERE severity_score >= 4 ORDER BY severity_score DESC LIMIT 12

label: Signals by type
sql: SELECT hazard_family AS type, count(*) AS signals, round(avg(severity_score), 1) AS avg_severity FROM gold_events GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY signals DESC

label: Where they are
sql: SELECT event_name AS event, state_or_region AS region, weather_city AS nearest_city, latitude, longitude FROM gold_events WHERE latitude IS NOT NULL ORDER BY severity_score DESC LIMIT 12
